description: This file defines the 'HiringManagerAPI' class, a REST API endpoint for listing available hiring managers (employees) within the recruitment module of an HRM system. It utilizes traits for employee, vacancy, and user role management, and includes a method to retrieve a filtered list of employees based on vacancy access rights. The class includes OpenAPI documentation annotations for the GET endpoint.

classes.name: HiringManagerAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class providing a GET method to list available hiring managers (employees) filtered by vacancy access rights. Implements collection endpoint functionality and uses traits for accessing vacancy, employee, and user role services.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles the retrieval of a list of hiring managers (employees) accessible to the current user, applying sorting and pagination. Returns the data as an EndpointCollectionResult containing EmployeeModel instances and metadata.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET /api/v2/recruitment/hiring-managers endpoint, mainly for sorting and pagination parameters.
